items.title: Myra Menville Interview, 1958-05-07, 09
items.q: this is quoting Glish, of a sort of an acrid sound

ctx.x: Were any of the discards intended as the defilences of a professor or...?

I don't think, I don't think they thought that. I think that, uh, the, uh, authorities, uh, and let's say, I'd name two that are, uh, backtracking in their early theories. Marshall Stern, whose book I love very much, uh, and Rudy Brush. I think both of them are backtracking on their... One of their statements was that Johnny Dodds purposely tuned his clarinet a little bit flat, because he said it gave the effect, and this is quoting Glish, of a sort of an acrid sound that was similar to vinegar in a salad.…

I assume that in the sense of the... the...the environment were interesting... the real stuff in the 30s, uh, I mean in the 40s, the middle 40s, early 40s came along, uh, a chap by the name of Scoop Kennedy, who is now connected with WDF, D-F-F-TV, who is an authority on cooking.
